_comment: Generated by tools/kod_extract/extract.py from system.kod SendCharInfo and GetAllowed*Icons - do not edit. Face parts are bgf names ('blank' = bald). The spell list assumes every spell is enabled; the server's own BP_CHARINFO is the truth.

spells.name: minor heal
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Bestows the healing touch of Shal'ille, restoring points of health.

spells.name: bless
spells.desc: Kraanan Lv. 2: Bestows the Warrior God's blessing, improving yourcombat abilities.

spells.name: poison
spells.desc: One of the many mystical spells.

spells.name: super strength
spells.desc: Kraanan Lv. 2: Infuses your body with superhuman strength in preparation for battle.

spells.name: touch of flame
spells.desc: Faren Lv. 2: Turns your touch into a blaze of searing flame, damaging your foes.

spells.name: holy touch
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Delivers the judgment of Shal'ille in your touch.

spells.name: zap
spells.desc: Faren Lv. 1: Channels natural electrical energy into a powerful charge which singes the target.

spells.name: icy fingers
spells.desc: Faren Lv. 2: Turns your touch to coldest ice, allowing for a damaging attack.

spells.name: withstand fire
spells.desc: Faren Lv. 2: Decreases the amount of damage you take from fire based attacks.

spells.name: illuminate
spells.desc: Faren Lv. 1:  Fills an area with magical illumination.

spells.name: remove curse
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Breaks the magical bond binding you to a cursed item.

spells.name: resist cold
spells.desc: Faren Lv. 2: Infuses your body with the magical fire of Faren, reducing damage from cold attacks.

spells.name: cure poison
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Fights the effects of any poisons which may flow through the target's body.

spells.name: darkness
spells.desc: Qor Lv. 1: Draws a curtain of darkness over the room, stirring the servants of Qor.

spells.name: acid touch
spells.desc: Qor Lv. 2: Covers caster's hands a powerful acid which penetrates armor, clothing, and flesh.

spells.name: create weapon
spells.desc: Kraanan Lv. 1: Creates a variety of weapons for use in defeating your foes.

spells.name: unholy weapon
spells.desc: Qor Lv. 2: Dedicates your weapon to Qor, enhancing its effectiveness against the holy.

spells.name: holy weapon
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Dedicates your weapon to Shal'ille, enhancing its effectiveness against the unholy.

spells.name: enchant weapon
spells.desc: Kraanan Lv. 2: Graces your weapon with a touch of magic, improving its damage.

spells.name: create food
spells.desc: Kraanan Lv. 1: Turns basic elderberries into food for you to eat and increase your vigor.

spells.name: Kara'hol's curse
spells.desc: Qor Lv. 2: Temporarily gives you berserker combat abilities, but with a price to pay later.

spells.name: haste
spells.desc: Kraanan Lv. 2: Allows you to use less stamina as you run.

spells.name: detect good
spells.desc: Qor Lv. 1: Allows you to detect good people and monsters.

spells.name: detect evil
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Allows you to detect evil people and monsters.

spells.name: holy symbol
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Weaves a holy symbol in the air which repels any nearby undead.

spells.name: breath of life
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Gives part of caster's health to another person.

spells.name: resist acid
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Coats your body in a magical goo which absorbs damage from acid attacks.

spells.name: fog
spells.desc: Faren Lv. 1: Summons a wall of billowing fog to confuse your foes.

spells.name: glow
spells.desc: Kraanan Lv. 1: Enchants a weapon or an instrument to glow like a torch.

spells.name: seance
spells.desc: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Gives a chance of knowing the location of the last person to have committed murder.

spells.name: sweep
spells.desc: Faren Lv. 1: Summons the winds of Faren to remove all loose items from the area.

spells.name: mystic touch
spells.desc: Faren Lv. 1: Gives part of caster's mana to another person.

spells.name: relay
spells.desc: Kraanan Lv. 1: Gives part of caster's vigor to another person.

spells.name: unholy touch
spells.desc: Qor Lv. 1: Delivers the evil of Qor in your touch.

skills.name: dodge
skills.desc: Weaponcraft Lv. 2: The ability to avoid blows in combat, and thus stay alive longer.

skills.name: block
skills.desc: Weaponcraft Lv. 1: The ability to block blows in combat, and thus stay alive longer.

skills.name: mining
skills.desc: Crafting Lv. 1: This skill allows you to break down heavy rocks and recover precious minerals.

skills.name: logging
skills.desc: Crafting Lv. 1: This skill allows you to chop down mature trees and recover precious minerals.

skills.name: gathering
skills.desc: Crafting Lv. 1: This skill allows you to gather useful plants for there fibers.

skills.name: skinning
skills.desc: Crafting Lv. 1: This skill allows you to gather hides from slain monsters.

skills.name: slash
skills.desc: Weaponcraft Lv. 1: The most basic skill of armed combat. A must for those who live by the blade.

skills.name: punch
skills.desc: Weaponcraft Lv. 1: The most basic of fighting skills, used by fighters and mages alike.

skills.name: brawling
skills.desc: Weaponcraft Lv. 2: Advanced tricks in unarmed combat, building on the punch skill.

skills.name: mace fighting
skills.desc: Weaponcraft Lv. 1: Skills in the land's most common, but least powerful, weapon.

skills.name: short sword fighting
skills.desc: Weaponcraft Lv. 2: Skill with the common short sword.
